summary: Iteration 2: feature-addition testing (LUNG PUNCH drop + countdown + HypeBar + studio photos). 17/17 backend pytest cases pass (9 products, all new fields populated, Lung Punch ~7d drop, persistence, orders, newsletter). Frontend home + producer page + card hype bars all render correctly with live ticking countdown. CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: HypeBar is imported in /app/frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.jsx (line 7) but NEVER rendered in JSX — limited product detail pages (e.g. /product/lung-punch-vinyl) do NOT show the detail hype bar, sold/total headline, full 4-unit countdown, or '% claimed' footer. Required test-ids hype-bar-detail-{slug} and countdown-detail-{slug} are absent from the DOM. Add-to-cart regression still works, no console errors anywhere.

ui_bugs.issue: HypeBar is imported but NEVER rendered. Limited product detail pages (/product/lung-punch-vinyl, /product/dez-tapes-vinyl, /product/beatsbydez-hoodie, /product/dez-signal-chain) are missing the detail-page hype bar entirely. Selectors hype-bar-detail-{slug} and countdown-detail-{slug} return null on the DOM.

action_items: Render <HypeBar product={product} /> inside /app/frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.jsx — suggested location: inside the right-hand details panel below the price block (around line 73, before the description) or below the description (around line 76). Only renders when product.total_supply is truthy (HypeBar already guards this). After fix, /product/lung-punch-vinyl should expose data-testid='hype-bar-detail-lung-punch-vinyl' and data-testid='countdown-detail-lung-punch-vinyl'; /product/dez-snapback should still NOT render (non-limited).
critical_code_review_comments: ProductDetail.jsx imports HypeBar (line 7) but the JSX never uses it — dead import + missing feature. ESLint react/no-unused-vars would catch this if enabled.

dez-tapes-vinyl has is_limited=True in seed but no total_supply/sold_count/drop_ends_at — its card will silently NOT render a HypeBar (HypeBar early-returns when total_supply is falsy). Either drop the is_limited flag or populate the three drop fields to stay consistent with the other 3 limited SKUs.
Countdown.jsx uses setInterval(1000) which keeps ticking across navigation but is cleaned up via useEffect cleanup — fine. No memoization concern.
Home.jsx hard-codes DEZ_LOGO and DEZ_STUDIO URLs identical to those in server.py — extract to a shared assets module to avoid drift.

Server still wipes products on every startup; new drop_ends_at is recomputed on each restart (datetime.now + Nd) so the visible countdown effectively resets on backend restart. Acceptable for MVP demo, but flag for production.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 1 artist + 9 products on every startup. Tests created TEST_-prefixed orders + a newsletter signup; no cleanup (acceptable per iteration 1 convention).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_dez_store.py now has 17 tests (added test_limited_products_have_drop_fields, test_lung_punch_product, test_non_limited_product_fields_null_or_zero). After main agent renders HypeBar inside ProductDetail.jsx, re-verify: (1) /product/lung-punch-vinyl shows data-testid='hype-bar-detail-lung-punch-vinyl' AND data-testid='countdown-detail-lung-punch-vinyl' with '387 of 1,000 sold' + 4-unit countdown + '% claimed' footer; (2) /product/dez-snapback does NOT render hype-bar-detail (non-limited guard). Card-level hype bars (hype-bar-card-{slug}, countdown-card-{slug}) and home countdown (home-lungpunch-countdown) already verified working. Console clean on home, product detail, producer page. Add-to-cart + cart persistence still working (regression smoke passed).
rca of the issue: ProductDetail.jsx was updated to import HypeBar but the developer omitted the JSX usage. Root cause: incomplete refactor — the import was added but the corresponding render was never placed inside the right-hand details panel. Reproduction: visit /product/lung-punch-vinyl in browser, inspect DOM for [data-testid^='hype-bar-detail'] — returns null. Mitigation: add `{product.total_supply && <HypeBar product={product} />}` (or just `<HypeBar product={product} />` since HypeBar already early-returns when total_supply is null) inside the details column of ProductDetail.jsx, recommended position: after the price line (around line 73) or after the description (line 76).
